listen_address.description: IP address to listen on for incoming DNS2TCP connections.

listen_port.description: Port number to listen on for incoming DNS2TCP connections.

run_as_user.description: User account under which the dns2tcp server process should run.

chroot_dir.description: Directory to chroot into for security isolation.

domain.description: The domain name used for the DNS2TCP tunneling service.

resources.description: Comma-separated list of resources to proxy (format: name:host:port).
